maria: Quick sync 90s90s: planning Apr 18 webinar. Need topic, short abstract, speakers, rehearsal slots. Reply with :+1: or edits.

alex: Two quick topics: low-latency ops or cost-reduction playbook. I prefer low-latency for enterprise hooks.

sam: low-latency works. I'll own benchmarks + demo (p50/p95/p99). Need sandbox key.

claire: Audience ~70% engineers, 20% infra, 10% execs. Abstract should call out practical knobs and one-line exec benefit.

maria: Draft short abstract: "Operationalizing low-latency inference: proven patterns for keeping tail latency predictable at scale. Benchmarks, routing patterns, and a live demo."

jon: Run-of-show (45m): 00:00-02:00 intro (maria); 02:00-18:00 benchmarks (sam); 18:00-30:00 demo+failover (sam+alex); 30:00-40:00 Q&A; 40:00-45:00 CTA.

alex: Rehearsals: tech run Apr 16 4pm PT, full dress Apr 17 11am PT. AV check 15m prior. rehearsal-bot: pls ping.

rehearsal-bot: Placeholders created and invites queued. Reminders 24h & 1h pre.

maria: Lead routing: SFDC campaign=Apr18-LowLat, priority if company size>2000 or pilot requested -> AE notif in #sales-inbound (no PII). Jon will test mapping.

jon: Will test SFDC->HubSpot->AE flow by Apr 17 EOD. Also drafting post-webinar email + 2-question survey.

sam: I'll upload slides + demo script by Apr 15 EOD. Sandbox creds will be time-limited.

maria: If no objections I'll lock this. :rocket:
